text:
alex: Quick thread 1: planning a coordinated unpin of SDK v2.7 and runtime v3.3 for the small canary (10% traffic) tomorrow night at 02:00 UTC. Theres a dependency: some high-volume tenants still on SDK v2.6 that require runtime v3.2 compatibility. Need a dry-run + clear rollback plan.

maria: Noted. Why both SDK and runtime together? can we split them?

alex: We could split but the compatibility matrix shows subtle behavior differences when SDK v2.7 + runtime v3.3 are paired vs runtime alone. Doing them together reduces rollout complexity (one canary) but increases blast radius.

jen: I'm leaning to staged approach: dry-run first (no traffic) then canary with traffic. Dry-run should use deploybot --dry-run to evaluate gates and produce a report.

deploybot: Deploybot: I can run a dry-run evaluation at scheduled time and post a gate report to this thread. Sample command: 
```
/deploybot unpin --component=runtime --version=v3.3 --component=sdk --version=v2.7 --cohort=canary --dry-run --gates=/etc/deploy/gates/sdk-rt-2-7-3-3.yaml
```

oli: Gate suggestions: SDK error uplift (client-side exceptions) < 0.2% vs baseline, server 5xx < 0.3%, median latency delta < +40ms, no tokenization regressions.

qa-bot: QA-Bot: enqueue smoke-eval run: smoke-sdk-rt-canary-v1. Will run synthetic conversational prompts and hallucination checks. Webhook will post pass/fail.

maria: prometheus queries for gate ingestion (feel free to copy):
```promql
# sdk client error pct
(sum(rate(redwood_sdk_client_errors_total{sdk_version=\"v2.7\"}[5m]))
/ sum(rate(redwood_sdk_client_requests_total{sdk_version=\"v2.7\"}[5m]))) * 100

# server 5xx rate for runtime v3.3
(sum(rate(redwood_runtime_requests_total{runtime=\"v3.3\",code=~\"5..\"}[5m]))
/ sum(rate(redwood_runtime_requests_total{runtime=\"v3.3\"}[5m]))) * 100
```

alex: Important: add a tenant-exclude list to the canary so large partners stay on stable for now. Well gradually onboard them in later waves. Put that list in the gates file.

jen: Rollback policy proposal: If ANY of the following happen within the first 15m of canary traffic, trigger rollback and open a postmortem ticket (assign to on-call)
- server 5xx rate > 0.5% for 3 consecutive 1m windows
- sdk client errors > 0.5% absolute increase vs baseline
- smoke-eval fail or hallucination delta > 2%
- token-drop samples > 10 in 1m (trace sampling)
Manual rollback allowed with `/deploybot rollback sdk=v2.7 runtime=v3.3 --reason=\"manual triage\"`.

oli: Add a preflight checklist:
- dry-run pass (deploybot reports gates ok)
- smoke-eval webhook returns pass
- release notes drafted and communication to CS (include tenant exclusions)
- on-call handoff (jen primary, oli secondary)

maria: Also include a short-lived trace link collection so we can look at sampled RPC traces for any increased tail latencies. Query for traces with runtime=v3.3 and sdk=v2.7.

deploybot: Acknowledged. I will include a \"gate-report\" artifact in the dry-run. If dry-run fails, I will not schedule canary. Dry-run scheduled command: 
```
/deploybot unpin --component=runtime --version=v3.3 --component=sdk --version=v2.7 --cohort=canary --dry-run --gates=/etc/deploy/gates/sdk-rt-2-7-3-3.yaml --report-channel=eng-releases
```

alex: Release notes snippet (jen can polish):
- \"Canary: SDK v2.7 + Runtime v3.3 rollout to 10% traffic. Tenant exclusions applied. Auto-rollback guards in place for errors, latency, and hallucination regressions. Contact eng-releases for questions.\"

jen: I'll draft and post to /release-notes/drafts tonight. Also will ping CS with the tenant exclusion table.

oli: On-call handoff: I'm backup but will be reachable. If rollback happens, please include changelog id and the dry-run gate report link in the PT so we can correlate.

alex: Decision: run dry-run at 01:00 UTC (no traffic), evaluate results, post gate-report. If dry-run green, proceed with canary at 02:00 UTC to 10% traffic with the gates above.

deploybot: Scheduled dry-run at 1729993200 (01:00 UTC). I will post the gate-report here when complete and set a tentative canary at 1729996800 (02:00 UTC) but will not run without explicit go from alex/jen.

qa-bot: Smoke eval queued for dry-run. Will post results to thread.

maria: One more: include a brief experiment tag in the gates file (exp=canary-sdk-rt-2024-08) so telemetry filtering is straightforward.

alex: Good catch. Add that tag and I'll approve gating file. Once dry-run report looks clean we'll mark go in this thread.

jen: I'll watch the dry-run and be ready to abort canary if anything smells off. Thanks team.

alex: Thanks all 1: leaving final sign-off to jen after dry-run. If no objection I'll close this thread after the report is posted. :thumbsup:
